I was stopped at a red light on the main road in Baytown, Texas, when the car behind me struck the rear of my
vehicle. The impact was hard enough to push me forward against my seatbelt, and I felt a sharp pain in my neck
almost immediately. I got out and spoke with the other driver, and I have described what happened the same way in

attending follow-up appointments. I am submitting this statement so the damage to my vehicle and my medical costs
